languagePicker.title: Choose your language
languagePicker.subtitle: You can change this anytime in Settings.

header.subtitle: Upload a .lua/.st file, select manifests, and download automatically

dotnetWarning.text: .NET 9 Runtime is required but not installed. DepotDownloader will not work without it.

search.noSourceLead: The app does not ship with any depot sources. Paste a URL pointing at a folder that follows the layout branches/<appid>/<files> (containing .lua, .manifest and optional key.vdf files). GitHub repos and archive.org/view_archive.php URLs are auto-detected; any plain HTTPS base URL also works.
search.inputPlaceholder: Search by name or App ID...

select.downloadLocationHint: Default: Documents/SteamDownloads — Game files will be saved in a subfolder here
select.manifestHubHint: Required for custom manifest IDs. Get your key at manifesthub1.filegear-sg.me

shortcut.title: Create Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Create desktop or start menu shortcuts to launch the downloaded game.
shortcut.exeHint: Auto-detected game executable. Click browse or select from detected files below.

cancel.title: Cancel Download?
cancel.body: Are you sure you want to cancel? All downloaded files for this App ID will be permanently deleted.

close.title: Close Application?
close.body: A download is in progress! Closing will cancel it and you may lose progress. Close anyway?

telemetry.title: Help improve the app?
telemetry.lead: We'd like to collect anonymous usage statistics so we know which features to invest in.
telemetry.collectItem3: A random install ID (not tied to you)
telemetry.neverItem1: Game IDs, depot IDs, file names
telemetry.hint: Events are end-to-end encrypted with a public key embedded in the app — only the maintainer's server can decrypt them. You can change your choice anytime in Settings → Advanced Settings.

update.title: Update Available
update.systemText: This build is installed by your package manager. Update with:

removeDefaultSource.title: Remove default source?
removeDefaultSource.body: This is a source that was installed with the app. Search by App ID will stop working until you add your own source. You can always re-add it later.

historyRemove.title: Remove entry?
historyRemove.body: This removes the entry from your history. Downloaded files stay on disk.

historyClear.title: Clear all history?
historyClear.body: This removes all entries from your history. Downloaded files stay on disk.

emuRevert.title: Revert emulator patch?
emuRevert.body: This restores the original Steam API library and removes the steam_settings folder. Your emulator settings will be lost.

folderMissing.title: Folder not found
folderMissing.body: The download folder no longer exists. It may have been moved or deleted.

emulator.title: Apply Emulator Patch
emulator.description: Replace the game's Steam API library with the gbe_fork emulator so the game can run without the Steam client.
emulator.variantRegularHint: Stable build, recommended for most games.
emulator.noFiles: No Steam API libraries were found in the download folder.
emulator.settingsHint: Unset values keep the gbe_fork defaults. You can change these later from the History tab.

fields.accountNameHint: Name the game sees from the Steam API.
fields.accountSteamIdHint: 64-bit Steam ID. Leave empty for the gbe_fork default.
fields.languageHint: Steam language code, e.g. english, german, french.
fields.ipCountryHint: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. US, DE, FR).
fields.localSavePathHint: Override where the emulator stores save data. Empty = gbe_fork default.
fields.savesFolderNameHint: Per-game subfolder name for save data.
fields.offlineHint: Force the emulator to act as if Steam is offline.
fields.steamDeckHint: Pretend the game runs on a Steam Deck.
fields.disableNetworkingHint: Block all network features (matchmaking, friends, P2P).
fields.disableLanOnlyHint: Allow connections beyond the local network.
fields.recordPlaytimeHint: Have the emulator track in-game playtime.
fields.achievementsBypassHint: Auto-unlock achievements as the game requests them.
fields.forceSteamhttpSuccessHint: Make all Steam HTTP requests appear to succeed.
fields.freeWeekendHint: Tell the game it is running during a free weekend.
fields.enableExperimentalOverlayHint: In-game ImGui overlay with achievement popups.
fields.overlayAlwaysShowFpsHint: Pin the FPS counter to the overlay.
fields.overlayAlwaysShowPlaytimeHint: Pin the session timer to the overlay.
fields.keyComboHint: Key combination to toggle the overlay (e.g. ShiftTab, CtrlShiftO).

emulator.editDescription: Change gbe_fork emulator settings for a previously patched game. Saving updates the steam_settings files in place.
emulator.editNoPatches: No patched Steam API files found in this game's folder.
emulator.lobbyNotPatched: No patched binaries in this game folder.
emulator.drmDescription: These executables are protected by Steam DRM (SteamStub). They won't run with the emulator until the DRM is removed.
emulator.drmRemoving: Removing DRM — this may take a minute...
emulator.drmRemoveSuccess: DRM removed from {count} file(s). Original kept as .drm.bak.
emulator.drmMonoHint: DRM removal on Linux/macOS requires `mono` (e.g. `pacman -S mono`, `apt install mono-runtime`, `brew install mono`).
emulator.bypassHint: Installs a version.dll next to the game that intercepts Steam-API integrity checks. Enable if the game refuses to launch with gbe_fork. Windows games only.
emulator.bypassSuccess: Steam API bypass installed for {count} target(s).

steamLibrary.title: Add to Steam Library
steamLibrary.description: Add this game to your Steam library as a non-Steam shortcut with full grid art. The game appears like any other Steam game.
steamLibrary.notDetected: No Steam installation with a signed-in user was found.
steamLibrary.exeHint: Auto-detected executable. Click Browse or pick from detected files.
steamLibrary.launchOptionsHint: Optional. For Windows games on Linux, set the Proton compatibility tool in Steam after adding.
steamLibrary.success: Added! Restart Steam to see {name} in your library.
steamLibrary.restartHint: Steam must be restarted for the new entry to appear.
steamLibrary.protonNote: Tip: After Steam restarts, right-click the entry → Properties → Compatibility and enable Proton to run this Windows game on Linux.
steamLibrary.windowsToggleHint: Creates a non-Steam shortcut with grid art so the game appears in your Steam library too.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoUpdateToggle: Automatically check for updates on startup
settings.autoUpdateHint: When enabled, the app checks for new versions on GitHub and offers to install them.
settings.languageHint: Switching the language requires restarting the app.
settings.ddExtraArgsHint: Additional command-line arguments passed to DepotDownloaderMod
settings.maxRetriesHint: Number of retry attempts when a depot download fails
settings.speedLimitHint: Leave empty for unlimited. Applied as DDM argument.
settings.proxyHint: Optional proxy URL (e.g., http://proxy:8080 or socks5://proxy:1080)
settings.depotSourcesHint: URLs pointing at a folder that follows the branches/<appid>/<files> layout (depot keys, manifests, key.vdf). Sources are queried in the order shown when searching by App ID.
settings.hubcapApiKeyHint: When set, App ID searches try hubcapmanifest.com first and fall back to the configured depot sources.
settings.notificationSoundToggle: Play a sound when downloads complete
settings.notificationSoundHint: Uses a system notification sound to alert you when all downloads finish.
settings.telemetryToggle: Send anonymous usage events to help improve the app
settings.telemetryHint: End-to-end encrypted. No game IDs, file contents, or account info are ever sent. Privacy details.
settings.debugInfoHint: Paste this into bug reports so the maintainer knows which build you're running.

errors.noManifests: No manifests found for this App ID in any configured depot source. Add or enable more sources in Settings.
errors.sourceProtocol: Must start with http:// or https://
